title: Country names merged
statementMd:
List all countries that appear either as an airline country or an airport country, once each.

Expected columns: `country`.

Tables: `airlines`, `airports`, `flights`, `bookings`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT country FROM airlines UNION SELECT country FROM airports;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
